description:
This file contains unit tests for an analyzer that checks for correct use of serialization attributes on Orleans grain classes. It verifies that classes inheriting from Grain or Grain<T> are not marked with serialization attributes like [Alias] or [GenerateSerializer], which are unnecessary for grain classes, while allowing such attributes on non-grain classes.

The code uses Xunit for testing, references Microsoft.CodeAnalysis for code analysis, and references Orleans.Analyzers for the specific analyzer under test.

classes.name: IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzer, checking detection of improper attribute usage on Orleans grain classes.

methods.description: Verifies that the provided code snippet does not trigger any diagnostics.
